name: spacebox-ui
description: Experience enhanced customization of VSCode UI, featuring animations, blur effects, and more.

spacebox-ui.defaultStyle.description: Enable the default SpaceBoxUI style style.
spacebox-ui.defaultStyle.markdownDescription: This will enable the default SpaceBoxUI style

spacebox-ui.blurEffect.description: Enable the blur effect. This includes the right-click context menu, menu bar, widgets, popups.

spacebox-ui.commandCenterBlur.description: Enable the command center menu blur.

spacebox-ui.importCss.description: Path to the custom CSS file. This file will be imported directly in VSCode style.

spacebox-ui.activityBarIndicatorColor.description: Custom color for the activity bar indicator bar. Leave empty to use default theme color.
spacebox-ui.activityBarIndicatorColor.markdownDescription: Custom color for the activity bar indicator bar (the vertical bar). Leave empty to use the default `--vscode-activityBar-activeBorder` color.

spacebox-ui.activityBarIndicatorBackgrou.description: Custom color for the activity bar indicator background. Leave empty to use default theme color.
spacebox-ui.activityBarIndicatorBackgrou.markdownDescription: Custom color for the activity bar indicator background (the highlight behind the icon). Leave empty to use the default `--vscode-activityBar-activeBorder` color.

spacebox-ui.quickInputPosition.description: Position of the quick input widget (Ctrl+Shift+P menu).
spacebox-ui.quickInputPosition.markdownDescription:
Position of the quick input widget (Ctrl+Shift+P menu).
- `top`: Default position at the top
- `center`: Centered on screen

spacebox-ui.quickInputTopMargin.description: Custom top margin for the quick input widget (e.g., '100px', '10%'). Only applies when position is 'top'.
spacebox-ui.quickInputTopMargin.markdownDescription: Custom top margin for the quick input widget (e.g., `100px`, `10%`). Only applies when position is set to `top`. Leave empty for default.

spacebox-ui.stylesheet.description: Custom CSS stylesheet as a JSON object. Edit in settings.json.
